description: This file defines CLI commands to manage a launchd agent, including installation, uninstallation, and status checking. It interacts with launchd by writing plist files and executing system commands.

classes.name: ServiceRootCommand
classes.description: Main command group for service management, including subcommands for install, uninstall, and status.

classes.name: ServiceInstall
classes.description: Command to install the launchd agent by creating and writing to the plist file.

classes.name: ServiceUninstall
classes.description: Command to remove the launchd agent plist file.

classes.name: ServiceStatus
classes.description: Command to check if the launchd agent plist exists, indicating installation status.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes the plist file to set up the launchd agent, given the executable path.
